file_stem: RWB TE 007 Scheduled jobs on Quartz
title: Scheduled jobs on Quartz
goal: Timer check, allocation and reconciliation run once per business date, on time and visibly
why: Two ACE instances share one Quartz store. A cluster lock gives one run per date; a 07:00 watcher alerts if allocation is late.
triggers: JOB-05 timer check, cron every 5 min
ace_note: No recovery.v_ace_* read. The trigger is the ACE batch event (EV-26) raised by E1-015; Quartz tables are shared with ACE.

writes.note: scheduler state; no new qrtz table

stores: Clustered Quartz job store (LocalDataSourceJobStore, PostgreSQLDelegate); run books JOB-03.md, JOB-04.md, JOB-05.md; operations alert channel

functions.name: RunBookCheck
functions.does: each job has a 6-heading run book

rules: BR1: once per business date, on one instance
BR2: JOB-03 and JOB-04 run only after JOB-02
BR3: JOB-03 must finish by 07:00 or an alert is raised
BR5: catch-up in date order, up to the limit (5 dates)
risks: More missed dates than the limit -> alert, no automatic catch-up (MSG-P3-031)
JOB-03 late at 07:00 -> alert within 15 minutes (MSG-P3-031)
example: COLLINS load for 2026-12-02 passed at 05:20, JOB-02 succeeded at 05:50
-> JOB-03 runs once on one instance and logs SUCCEEDED with case counts
